title: Tuesday · fractions, rights and French
arrival: Answer attendance, then hand in any forms. Get your materials ready.
note: French is 12:35–1:35. Tomorrow is Remembrance Day: school is closed. Resume maths and reading from confirmed progress. The rights bridge has a complete paper route.

blocks.title: Welcome and attendance
blocks.firstAction: Answer attendance, then hand in forms.

blocks.title: Maths · two names for one amount
blocks.firstAction: Draw equal wholes divided into fourths.
blocks.notes: Begin with Monday’s actual learning. Show 9/4 = 2 1/4: two groups of four fourths and one fourth remain. Reverse with 2 2/3 = 8/3. Practise 7/2 = 3 1/2 and 3 1/4 = 13/4. Keep the whole and denominator unchanged. Exit: model 8/3 and explain 2 2/3. Provide counters/strips and oral explanation; not a dedicated GCF/LCM lesson.
studentSteps: Group the fractional parts into wholes.
Write both names and explain why they match.

blocks.title: Nevermoor and evidence
blocks.notes: Resume the real bookmark. Students give one interpretation and one supporting detail. Other supported readings are welcome; record the new bookmark.
studentSteps: Choose one detail and explain what it suggests.
Save a question for next time.

blocks.title: Snack
blocks.firstAction: Have your snack and tidy your space.

blocks.title: Social Studies · rights and real access
blocks.notes: Use the linked 35-minute rights bridge, then discuss or finish existing work. Fictional sources are practice, not evidence about a real country. Distinguish what a right promises from what makes it possible to use.

blocks.title: Lunch
blocks.firstAction: Follow our outside-play and lunch routine.

blocks.title: Quiet work and reflection
blocks.firstAction: Choose one useful next step in existing work.
blocks.notes: Improve a detail, explanation or reflection using the original instructions. Save progress without adding a new upload.

blocks.title: Save, tidy and move
blocks.firstAction: Save your work, complete classroom jobs and join a short movement break when directed.

blocks.title: Pack up and dismissal
blocks.firstAction: Check your belongings and prepare for dismissal.

backups: Use paper, oral explanation or drawings when devices are unavailable. Technology bookings are proposed, not confirmed.
